THE MARINER.name: THE MARINER
must_mention_scenes: EXT. RUDDY & GREENE BUILDING - REAR - NIGHT
BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. COASTLINE - DAY - PAST
BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. BACKYARD - DAY - PAST
key_facts: His real name is Billy (or Will)
Rose is his sister
His fishing-themed combat gear includes anchor bracers, a weighted net cape, fish hooks, an oar, and a flare gun
He tracked Rose via AirTag
He believed his father was dead
His father actually abandoned him
He romanticized his abusive childhood
He has a moral code he calls the Mariner's code
Rose's final speech helps him reclaim his identity as a hero independent of his father
Dad identifies their family name as MacAngus; the rescue van is separately branded McAngus Fish & Brewis

ROSE.name: ROSE
must_mention_scenes: EXT. RUDDY & GREENE BUILDING - REAR - NIGHT
key_facts: She is Mariner's sister
She wears a Tim Hortons uniform
She stole about $20 million in gang money controlled through a blockchain password
Vinnie was her ex-boyfriend
She knows the truth about their father
She delivers the final speech redefining Mariner as a hero
The password is hidden on a chip in her purse lining

DAD.name: DAD
must_mention_scenes: BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. COASTLINE - DAY - PAST
BEGIN FLASHBACK: EXT. BACKYARD - DAY - PAST
key_facts: He appears only in flashbacks
He is presented in two versions: idealized and dark/true
The idealized version shows warm teaching moments
The dark version reveals physical abuse and alcoholism
He abandoned Mariner and lives in Chimney Bay
Mariner believed he was dead
His 'hero' speech is self-aggrandizing in the dark version
He is a fisherman
He speaks in a Newfoundland/Maritime dialect (b'y, bosun, 'e, anudder)

SALVATORI.name: SALVATORI
key_facts: He confronts Rose in a luxurious 15th-floor office with armed thugs
He is dressed entirely in white with red-tinted glasses
Rose stole $20 million from his gang
He demands the password from Rose at gunpoint
He has a white moustache, hoop earring, and gold rings

VINNIE.name: VINNIE
key_facts: He is Rose's ex-boyfriend
He works for Salvatori's gang
He convinced Rose to rob the gang
He is hit by Mariner's flare gun in the chest
He patrols the 13th floor with Mikey and Carlos

ROSCO.name: ROSCO
key_facts: He ambushes Rose and Mariner by opening the 12th-floor stairwell door
Under threat from Rose, he explains blockchain and reveals that Salvatori is involved
His interrupted warning reveals that Rose took about $20 million
Mariner cracks his head into the stairwell wall and Rosco crumples

MIKEY.name: MIKEY
must_have_evidence: holding Mikey and Carlos by the necks
key_facts: He patrols the 13th floor with Vinnie and Carlos
He mocks Mariner's fishing theme and flare gun
Mariner drops him by cracking his head against Carlos's

CARLOS.name: CARLOS
must_have_evidence: holding Mikey and Carlos by the necks
wipes his BLOODY OAR on Carlos’ back
key_facts: He patrols the 13th floor with Vinnie and Mikey
He orders Rose and Mariner to the ground at gunpoint
Mariner drops him by cracking his head against Mikey's

THUG 1.name: THUG 1
must_have_evidence: Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest
key_facts: He is one of three gunmen waiting when the elevator opens on the 12th floor
Mariner knocks away his gun and side-kicks him into the other thugs

THUG 2.name: THUG 2
must_have_evidence: Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON
key_facts: He reports Rose and Mariner's location by radio
He draws a gun with Thug 3 and lunges for the elevator button
Mariner strikes him with the oar through the closing elevator doors

THUG 3.name: THUG 3
must_have_evidence: Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND
key_facts: He is one of three gunmen waiting when the elevator opens on the 12th floor
He draws a gun with Thug 2 after Thug 1 is knocked into them

THUGS.name: THUGS
must_have_evidence: Two THUGS burst in through the office doors
kick the back of his legs
key_facts: Two armed thugs enter the 15th-floor office immediately before Salvatori
They disarm Mariner and force him to kneel during Salvatori's confrontation with Rose
